summary: Implemented durable execution ownership with random owner/attempt identities, monotone epoch and expiring leases; every agent mutation is fenced inside its workspace transaction.
Cross-instance cancellation and expired/shutdown owners cannot append steps, proposals, connector check artifacts or terminal results, including when network work ignores AbortSignal.
Queued runs survive process loss; local execution and durable per-workspace queue/concurrency are bounded. RunQueueFullError is exported and the stream/auth lane added HTTP 429 mapping.

Startup recovers queued work and visibly interrupts abandoned running work without replay or historical backfill. Shutdown aborts/fences active work and drains execution promises within a configured bound.
Agent step events publish only after durable append and audit commit.

New execution options, limits, fence identity and ownership predicate.

limitations: Worker ran bounded SQLite focused tests only. The two-service SQLite fixture shares one Store/connection; the same fixture opens independent stores for PostgreSQL, which remains lead-owned and was not run by this worker.

No full suites, build, browser suite, migration, deployment, git action, dependency modification, live database access or external agent/model dispatch performed. Root M2 application files were not modified.

New execution metadata is optional for historical records. Startup marks only queued/running work; terminal historical runs are not backfilled. Abandoned running work is failed/interrupted and never automatically replayed.

Queue options are service configuration (defaults: 2 local executors, 1 executor per workspace, 32 queued per workspace, 30s lease, 5s heartbeat). Scheduler scans at most 256 active records per pass. This is bounded behavior, not a measured pilot capacity claim.

Uncooperative network work can continue externally after cancellation, but persisted writes require the still-valid owner/attempt/epoch lease under the workspace lock. Shutdown bounds waiting on execution promises; existing server outer deadline also bounds cleanup/database waits.
Direct recorderless createProposal remains an explicitly trusted service/fixture path. Runtime agent proposal and connector paths carry and validate persisted run fences.

Whole-file hashes snapshot shared checkout bytes at report time; owned scopes identify only this node delta. Citation type additions and other workers app/auth/claims changes are not claimed here. Lead may subsequently change shared service bytes during strict proposal-validation integration.

Full integration, independent review, PostgreSQL confirmation and final cross-worker typecheck are lead-owned and pending this report; stream/auth worker separately reported server/web typecheck and 45 auth/stream focused tests passing.
